question: Which of the following is NOT one of the five outlined pillars of Atmanirbhar Bharat?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Resilience**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat** or **Self-Reliant India** is an initiative by the Government of India to make the country independent and self-sustaining.
 
• The initiative is based on five pillars which are: **Economy, Infrastructure, System, Demography, and Demand**.
 
• **Economy**: Focuses on quantum jumps rather than incremental changes.
 
• **Infrastructure**: Represents modern infrastructure that becomes the identity of India.
 
• **System**: A technology-driven system that fulfills the 21st-century dreams of India.
 
• **Demography**: The vibrant demography of India, which is our strength.
 
• **Demand**: The cycle of demand and supply chain in the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Economy**__

 __
 
• Emphasizes on creating a robust economic framework to support growth and development.
 
• Aims at making India a global manufacturing hub.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure**__
 __
 
• Focuses on developing world-class infrastructure across the country.
 
• Includes initiatives like Smart Cities Mission, Bharatmala Project, and Sagarmala Project.
 
 
 
• **Demand**__
 
 
• Aims at boosting the domestic demand to drive economic growth.
 
• Focuses on increasing consumption to support local industries.
